strugglebug.d: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 1.

substitute.d: User takes 1/4 its max HP to put in a substitute.

suckerpunch.d: Usually goes first. Fails if target is not attacking.

sunnyday.d: For 5 turns, intense sunlight powers Fire moves.

supercellslam.d: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.

superfang.d: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.

superpower.d: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

supersonic.d: Causes the target to become confused.

surf.d: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dive.

swagger.d: Raises the target's Attack by 2 and confuses it.

swallow.d: Heals the user based on uses of Stockpile.

sweetkiss.d: Causes the target to become confused.

swift.d: This move does not check accuracy. Hits foes.

switcheroo.d: User switches its held item with the target's.

synchronoise.d: Hits adjacent Pokemon sharing the user's type.

synthesis.d: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

syrupbomb.d: Target's Speed is lowered by 1 stage for 3 turns.

tailwind.d: For 4 turns, allies' Speed is doubled.

taunt.d: Target can't use status moves its next 3 turns.

tearfullook.d: Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.

teatime.d: All active Pokemon consume held Berries.

telekinesis.d: For 3 turns, target floats but moves can't miss it.

temperflare.d: Power doubles if the user's last move failed.

terablast.d: If Terastallized: Phys. if Atk > SpA, type = Tera.

terrainpulse.d: User on terrain: power doubles, type varies.

thief.d: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.

thrash.d: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

throatchop.d: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound moves.

thunder.d: 30% chance to paralyze. Can't miss in rain.

thunderfang.d: 10% chance to paralyze. 10% chance to flinch.

tickle.d: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1.

tidyup.d: User +1 Atk, Spe. Clears all substitutes/hazards.

torchsong.d: 100% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

torment.d: Target can't select the same move twice in a row.

toxic.d: Badly poisons the target. Poison types can't miss.

toxicspikes.d: Poisons grounded foes on switch-in. Max 2 layers.

toxicthread.d: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 and poisons it.

trailblaze.d: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.

transform.d: Copies target's stats, moves, types, and Ability.

triattack.d: 20% chance to paralyze or burn or freeze target.

trick.d: User switches its held item with the target's.

trickortreat.d: Adds Ghost to the target's type(s).

trickroom.d: Goes last. For 5 turns, turn order is reversed.

tripleaxel.d: Hits 3 times. Each hit can miss, but power rises.

tropkick.d: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

trumpcard.d: More power the fewer PP this move has left.

twineedle.d: Hits 2 times. Each hit has 20% chance to poison.

twister.d: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

upperhand.d: 100% flinch. Fails unless target using priority attack.

uproar.d: Lasts 3 turns. Active Pokemon cannot fall asleep.

uturn.d: User switches out after damaging the target.

venomdrench.d: Lowers Atk/Sp. Atk/Speed of poisoned foes by 1.

venoshock.d: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.

vitalthrow.d: This move does not check accuracy. Goes last.

voltswitch.d: User switches out after damaging the target.

volttackle.d: Has 33% recoil. 10% chance to paralyze target.

wakeupslap.d: Power doubles if target is asleep, and wakes it.

waterfall.d: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

waterpledge.d: Use with Grass or Fire Pledge for added effect.

watershuriken.d: Usually goes first. Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

watersport.d: For 5 turns, Fire-type attacks have 1/3 power.

weatherball.d: Power doubles and type varies in each weather.

whirlpool.d: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

whirlwind.d: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

wideguard.d: Protects allies from multi-target moves this turn.

wish.d: Next turn, 50% of the user's max HP is restored.

wonderroom.d: For 5 turns, all Defense and Sp. Def stats switch.

workup.d: Raises the user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.

wrap.d: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

wringout.d: More power the more HP the target has left.

yawn.d: Puts the target to sleep after 1 turn.

zenheadbutt.d: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

zippyzap.d: Goes first. Raises user's evasion by 1.
